L1 nginx -t
L1 nginx -s reload
L1 caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
L1 caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
L1 tee /etc/nginx/conf.d/hostower-app.example.com.conf
L1 systemctl reload nginx
L0 tail -n 200 /var/log/nginx/hostower-app.example.com.access.log
L0 sudo -n tail -n 200 /var/log/nginx/hostower-app.example.com.error.log

# ---- certbot：列证书是只读；申请、续期是变更；删除和吊销是高危 ----
L0 certbot certificates
L0 sudo -n certbot certificates
L1 certbot certonly --webroot -w /var/www/hostower-acme -d app.example.com --non-interactive --agree-tos --register-unsafely-without-email --keep-until-expiring --deploy-hook 'systemctl reload nginx'
L1 certbot renew --dry-run
L1 certbot renew
L1 certbot --version
L2 certbot delete --cert-name app.example.com
L2 certbot revoke --cert-name app.example.com
L3 cat /etc/letsencrypt/live/app.example.com/privkey.pem

# ---- 应用连数据一起删（apps.PlanAction 的 purge）：容器写出的 root 文件当前账号删不掉、sudo 又被禁止提权时，借一个临时容器删，整条仍是 L2 ----
L2 cd ~/.hostower/apps/uptime-kuma && docker compose -p uptime-kuma down -v && cd && { rm -rf ~/.hostower/apps/uptime-kuma 2>/dev/null || sudo -n rm -rf ~/.hostower/apps/uptime-kuma 2>/dev/null || { docker run --rm -v "$HOME/.hostower/apps/uptime-kuma:/d" busybox:1.37 sh -c 'rm -rf /d/* /d/.[!.]* /d/..?*' && rm -rf ~/.hostower/apps/uptime-kuma; }; }
